meta.law: Madsen (Madsen, Poon & Graber 1988), as SWAN implements it
meta.quantity: -ln(energy flux surviving bottom friction), deep water to the start depth
meta.nodes: peak_hz x tide_m x hs_m, C order (hs fastest)
meta.hs: the break's linear (frictionless) Hs at the start depth
meta.tide: coast level on MSL; depths along the path are h + tide, no shallower than H_LAND
meta.rows: row k (its place among its frequency's rows in <break>.csv) -> the path it crosses the shelf on; a path's loss = sum of its weights times the frequency's basis rows
